samples: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
what: A recursive function kept calling itself without reaching a base case, so the call stack filled up. Add a condition that stops the recursion.

street.headline: Your function dey call itself forever
street.happen: One function keep calling itself and e never reach a place to stop. The call stack don full.
street.todo: Add a base case wey go stop the recursion:
street.learn: Every function call take space on the call stack. Recursion need a base case.

normal.headline: Your function no get base case
normal.happen: A function keep calling itself without a base case, so the call stack fill up.
normal.todo: Add a condition wey go stop the recursion:
normal.learn: Recursion need a base case, or e go run until the stack full.
